description: Header file defining functions for configuring hostapd settings related to wireless access points, including creation, update, and configuration hashing.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_create
methods.description: Creates a configuration file for hostapd based on radio settings and a filename.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_update
methods.description: Updates an existing hostapd configuration for a given interface and key-value pair.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_setVapConfig
methods.description: Sets Virtual Access Point (VAP) configuration parameters.

methods.name: wld_hostapd_cfgFile_genConfigHash
methods.description: Generates a hash representing the current configuration state.
